detail.title: Magnetic Cooling Pad for Mobile
detail.overview: Discover the Magnetic Cooling Pad for Mobile by Bestor, engineered for high performance, durability, and seamless connectivity.
features: It cools your device to 59°F-64°F in under 9 sec.

Lightweight and compatible with most 4.5-7 inch phones.
Easy setup with Type C plug and included USB C cable.
Ideal for Gamers, Live streamers and extended device usage.
Trust in Bestor Brand for innovative, reliable & high-performance.
